rule.statement: Only the headline is ever reproduced, exactly as the publication printed it. No quotation is generated, paraphrased, summarised or reconstructed anywhere in this file.
rule.match: The headline names a roster member (whole word, published alias table) AND carries a speech cue.
rule.match_direct: Or: the entry was published on the person's own feed, or on their organisation's official feed with them as the author or named in the title (with a speech cue, or as an official video upload).
rule.no_line_means: No headline in this corpus named this person beside a speech cue. It is not a claim that the person said nothing.

cues.quoted_text: double quotes, two words or more

class_means.verb: the headline's own verb is an act of speech
class_means.appearance: the headline names a venue or a format — interview, podcast, keynote, testimony
class_means.document: a document names the person. It may be by them or about them; the headline is the only thing that can tell you, and it is printed in full
class_means.quote: the publication put words in quotation marks in its own headline
class_means.official: not a press headline: the title of an entry on the person's own feed, or on their organisation's official feed under their name

reason_means.quiet: At least one official source answered, and neither it nor the press carried anything from this person in the window.
reason_means.sources_unreachable: This person has official sources and none of them answered this run, so the silence may be ours rather than theirs.
reason_means.no_sources: No official feed is known for this person; the press wire is the only reading.

direct.last_statement_means: The newest dated statement this wire has ever attributed to the person — from the press window, the full history of their official feeds, or the memory carried forward from previous runs.

coverage.source: Google News search RSS (news.google.com/rss/search), one exact-phrase query per person
coverage.means: Stories in the press that mention the person, counted as distinct (title, outlet) pairs ever observed. Coverage is not a statement: it never puts anyone on the record, and only the outlet's own headline is shown.
coverage.trend_means: Week over week: this 7 days against the 7 before. Shown only once a full previous week has been observed; flat inside ±10% or ±2 stories.
coverage.profile_source: Wikipedia REST summary (en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary), CC BY-SA 4.0, refreshed at most daily
